warnings: SOIL BEARING 8 Ton/m² / เสาเข็ม I-0.18 x 6.00ม. - 2.5 Ton/Pile printed at the top of the sheet, used to confirm pile capacity assumptions made when reading the footing plan (S-02) — both sheets agree.

F2's section shows 9-Ø9 main bars (not 4 as the footing plan's 4+4 was read) with 4-Ø12 additional bars and 1-Ø9 รัดรอบ stirrup, resting on 2 piles — F2 is a 2-pile footing, not 4-pile; the plan's 4+4 was a misread of the 9-Ø9 label. Flagged rather than silently corrected.

F3 (pentagon-shaped, 4 piles) and F4 (square, 4 piles) both show 8+8-Ø12 main bars in their sections (4 per pile, 2 piles per direction) with 1-Ø9 รัดรอบ stirrup — consistent with each other and with the 4-pile plan marks.
F5 (5 piles) shows 7+7-Ø16 main bars (7 per pile) with 1-Ø9 รัดรอบ stirrup — the largest footing on the sheet, matching its position at the heavy interior column.
S0 (slab-on-grade edge detail, 1:25) shows 1-Ø9 @0.25 reinforcement mesh over 0.10m sand fill, with 1" pipe wrapped in foam or asphalt-sand mortar — typical edge-slab detail, no grid position needed.

CN column pedestal detail (0.15x0.15m, 4-Ø12 main bars, ป Ø6@0.20 stirrup) shown alongside a 'ขยายรอยต่อเสา CN และคานคสล' joint detail with SILICONE BUILDING SEALANTS — confirms CN is a short RC pedestal, not a full-height column.
S0, F2-F5, CN, and the SP joint detail are all 1:25 scale per the sheet's own legend — cross-checked against the sheet title block's 1:25 master scale.
